sources.title: China Adds Power 8x More Than the US in 2025

checks.explanation: The predicted decade-long window hasn't elapsed.

Humanoid robot deployment has scaled fast (from roughly 3,000 units in 2024 to an estimated 50,000 operating commercially in 2026), a real acceleration, but nowhere near the '100 million electrified robots' scale implied, and the window (roughly 2025-2027) hasn't closed.

sources.title: What Are Humanoid Robots? The State of Robotics in 2026

checks.explanation: Small modular reactors remain pre-commercial as of 2026, while natural gas (LNG-fired) power plants have indeed filled most of the near-term new demand from AI data centers, matching the prediction.
